related_codes.SA832: notice to file withdrawn (no return needed for that year)
related_codes.SA818: you still need to fill in a tax return
related_codes.SA251: an update on your Self Assessment (last return you need to file)
related_codes.SA981: decision that no return was needed

heading_phrases: Notice to complete a tax return
You need to send us a tax return
not_this_letter_if: the letter charges a penalty (use the penalty rules)

deadlines.paper: 31 October after the end of the tax year
deadlines.online: 31 January after the end of the tax year
deadlines.late_notice_rule: If the notice is dated after 31 October, the deadline is 3 months from the date of the notice (for paper and online).

facts_for_explanation.what_it_is: HMRC is asking you to send a Self Assessment tax return for the tax year shown. Once HMRC sends this notice, you must file, even if you think you owe no tax.
points: If you miss the deadline, there is an automatic £100 penalty, then more penalties after 3, 6 and 12 months.
If you think you don't need to file, tell HMRC before the deadline (online checker or by phone). HMRC can withdraw the notice.
